race.description: Tab One Pool Edward Manifold Stakes (G2)
race.comment: Keen to be with PROFLIGATE (3) who gets to a mile third up on the bigger track. Outside of Pretty Baby she was arguably the run of the race first up in the Atlantic Jewel then she closed off well in the Thousand Guineas Prelude, unsuited staying at 1400m and not handling Caulfield all that well. 1600m on the big track here looks ideal. PORTINARI (5) beat her home at Sandown then went back and ran on strongly for fourth at Caulfield after getting a long way back. Drawn wide again and not convinced she's crying out for a mile but she'll take beating. SAINTLY DANCER (2) beat them both home when 2nd in the Prelude, given a very easy time up on speed. She can roll forward again and give a huge sight. STIPULATION (11) chased Thousand Guineas favourite Regal Ambition two back then won well latest. She should relish a mile and can measure up. JOELY (14) got way too far back in the Prelude and looks suited up in trip.
